title: LPU NAME SERVICE
tagline: Name Service for students to claim their credentials and documents which will be issued as NFT by Universities, like certificates and documents.
description: This project uses Ethereum name services to give a unique identity to students within universities for them to claim any credentials or documents issued by universities. Students will be able to receive certificates from different sources in their wallet using this simple easy-to-use and remember address with the university name extension.
how_its_made: The project is created using a smart contract that is deployed to Mumbai testnet and a frontend to easily interact with the interface. The app is then deployed to vercel to interact live on the internet. The solidity language is used to create the smart contract. The linking of frontend with smart contract was a hectic process and after some hit and trail method I got the app working.
